Options.OPTION[SkiResortMod.SkiResortMod: Show the Ski Resort button (top left)
Shows a Ski Resort button at the top left of the screen that opens the hub: your runs, the resort totals and every building tool in one place. The hub is also always in the Universal Mod Panel. Mouse and keyboard layout only.
Options.OPTION[SkiResortMod.SkiResortMod: Open the hub when a Welcome Sign is selected
Selecting a Ski Area Welcome Sign opens the Ski Resort hub beside its panel. It never closes the hub; close it with its X or Escape.
How often residents spend a day out skiing. More attraction, fresh snow and a shorter trip bring more; a lift ticket price above 40 brings fewer. 0 turns ski days off for residents. Default 25 %.
How often hotel guests spend a day out skiing, moved by the same things. 0 turns ski days off for tourists. Default 50 %.
Nobody farther than this from a lodge, in a straight line, is sent skiing there. Fewer come the farther they live. Default 7.
How much a fresh-snow day adds. At 100 % a full powder day doubles the residents who go; at 0 powder brings no extra skiers. Default 100 %.

How much a ski area's runs and lifts add to its attraction score. Score = lodge base + K times the square root of its runs and running lifts, times variety and vertical, then times the Welcome Sign's efficiency, at most 200. Default 4: in winter, with every run open, at full efficiency, a small ski area scores about 50, a medium one about 95, a large one about 160.
What a run that no running lift serves is worth, as a percentage of a lift-served run. A run is lift-served when a complete, powered lift reaches its top. Default 40 %.

What each guest pays on arrival, one price for every ski area. Above 40 it lowers ski days (about 90 % as many at 60, 80 % at 80, 20 % at 200); visitors the game sends on its own come at any price and still pay it. 0 turns lift tickets off. Default 80.

What each paying ski guest also spends at the lodge they arrive at, more at bigger lodges: at the default, 15 at a hut or A-frame, 23 at a chalet and 45 at a summit or grand lodge. It comes out of what the household has left after the lift ticket, so nothing is spent while lift tickets are off. 0 turns it off. Default 15.
Options.OPTION[SkiResortMod.SkiResortMod: Book resort income as public transportation fees
On: lift tickets, season passes, lessons and lodge spend are booked as public transportation fees and reach your balance through the game's budget. Off: they go straight to your balance. Default on.

At a ski area with a working ski school, this share of the people who go skiing that day also take a lesson. The household pays from what it has left after the lift ticket or pass. 0 turns lessons off. Default 30 %.
A lesson costs this many lift tickets at the day's ticket price. Needs a lift ticket price above 0. Default 1.5.

On: when a ski area has had no open run for half a day, its lodges and ski school keep half their jobs, so half the wages, until a run opens again. Upkeep stays. To cut a closed lodge further, set it Inactive in its info panel (a tenth of its upkeep, no wages). Default on.

The share of resident households that buy a season pass (July to June). Each household within reach rolls once when a ski area opens for a new season, at this share times its chance of skiing there; households that moved in later or live farther away roll on their first visit. Holders ski free at the gate and go skiing more often. Tourists never buy one. 0 turns passes off. Default 50 %.

A season pass costs this many lift tickets at the ticket price when it is sold, locked for the season. It pays off for a household that skis more often than this many times. Needs a lift ticket price above 0. Default 2.

On: a run adds to its ski area's score only while snow lies on it - open when 60 % of it has 3 ft (91 cm) of snow, closed below 40 % (measured in the game's own snow, or estimated from the climate until the first measurement). A ski area with no open run counts as summer sightseeing. Off: every run counts as open all year, for maps without winter. Runs pay upkeep only while their grooming or snow guns run, so on a warm map with gating off they cost no upkeep. Default on.

Snow guns on snowmaking and night runs work where the air on the run is at most this many degrees above freezing, from October to March, until the run has 3 ft (91 cm) of snow. Higher means a longer season and a bigger snowmaking bill. Default 3.3 (38 F).

Ski runs paint the terrain itself using one of the map's four extra material slots. Auto uses a free slot only; many maps have none, and runs then fall back to flat painted surfaces. Force replaces that map material with ski-run snow everywhere the map author painted it (usually small areas, so check your map), and erases the map's paint of that material under and around your ski runs: once the city is saved, that paint stays erased, and switching the option back does not restore it. Nothing is touched until the city has its first ski run. Takes effect when a save loads.
Options.OPTION[SkiResortMod.SkiResortMod: Bind runs the moment they are drawn
When enabled, a run drawn within 5 km of a Ski Area Welcome Sign joins the resort (and is charged) immediately, even while paused, and waiting runs join the moment a sign is placed. Disabled, runs join on the next periodic check, which only happens while the game is running. Default on.

When enabled, drawing or editing a ski run shows a slope heat-map over the run (gray flat, green, blue, black, red double black) and a tooltip with its rating, hardest unavoidable pitch, length and vertical drop. Default on.
When enabled, terrain contour lines turn on while a ski run is selected in the area tool and turn off again afterwards. If you already had them on, they stay on. Default on.
Options.OPTION[SkiResortMod.SkiResortMod: Show the winter snow line while placing
When enabled, drawing a ski run or placing a Ski Area Welcome Sign draws two lines on the terrain: the average winter snow line (where the December-February average climate reaches freezing, even in summer) and a fainter one below it where snow guns start to work. The tooltip gives both heights. Default on.
Options.OPTION[SkiResortMod.SkiResortMod: Show run names on the hill
When enabled, each ski run's name is written on the ground at the run's center, in its difficulty color, while the camera is at piste-map distance. Handy in summer, when the runs carry no snow. The names step aside while you draw or edit a run. Default on.
How thick the outline and corner dots are while you draw, edit or bulldoze a ski run. 0 keeps the game's thin outline. Default 8.
Options.OPTION[SkiResortMod.SkiResortMod: Snow lances, fan guns and hydrants
How many corners of snowmaking and night runs get a snow lance, fan gun or hydrant, in percent of the full look. Look only: snow and upkeep follow the run type. Runs already built change when you move the slider in a city; saved runs keep their look until edited. Default 100 %.

How many corners of night runs get a floodlight mast, in percent of the full look. Look only: snow and upkeep follow the run type, and night skiing does not need the masts. Runs already built change when you move the slider in a city; saved runs keep their look until edited. Default 100 %.

Snow guns on snowmaking and night runs show a vapor plume while they make snow: cold enough at the gun and the run's snow below the depth where the guns stop. Look only: snow and upkeep do not change. Default on.
The steepest a cat track may climb. A track that cannot stay under it turns red and asks for more length (a switchback). Default 25 %.
Width of the cat track: the flat top the tool cuts and fills, and the run built on it. Default 20 m.
Meters out per meter down where the track cuts into the hill. Lower is steeper. Default 1.5.
Meters out per meter up where the track is built up. Lower is steeper. Default 2.
Off: the track follows the ground and moves as little earth as the max grade allows. On: one even slope from end to end. Default off.

Outline a mountainside and the planner proposes a set of linked runs you can review, change and build in one go, with an optional tree filler. Experimental. Off: the tool cannot open and its hub button is grayed. Default off.
Guide line and offset readout while placing a station; a warning on the bulldozer showing what a click on a lift removes. Default on.

After you draw or change a lift line, its towers are raised and moved along the line so the chairs and cabins stay at least 3 m above the ground (trams 5 m). Off: the towers stay where the game puts them. Default on.

For field tests, off by default. Turns on extra measurements that cost a little frame time (a daily ski-day measurement pass and the Ctrl+Alt+G slope capture file). Leave it off for normal play. Default off.
Puts every Modular Ski Resort option and key binding back to its default. Asks you to confirm first.
Options.WARNING[SkiResortMod.SkiResortMo: Reset all Modular Ski Resort options and key bindings to their defaults?
Removes everything Modular Ski Resort placed in this city: lifts and their towers, stations, lodges, the ski school, patrol huts, Welcome Signs, ski runs, cat tracks, safety fences and the trees the glade tool or the Resort Planner planted. Use it before you unsubscribe. Your own power lines, roads and buildings are not touched. Terrain graded for cat tracks stays as it is, snow already on the runs melts with the weather, and felled trees do not come back. If one of your power lines ends at a base station, bulldoze that last span first. This cannot be undone: save your city first. Available only in a loaded city.
Options.WARNING[SkiResortMod.SkiResortMo: Delete every lift, station, lodge, run, cat track and fence of Modular Ski Resort in this city? This cannot be undone.
Opens or closes the ski-run glade tool. Point at a run of a ski area to preview it at the chosen tree density (felled, removed and planted trees); left click applies. Works in a loaded city only. Default Ctrl+Shift+G.

Opens or closes the lift-line tool: click a lift station, then the other station of the same lift. The planned towers appear (fewest towers, tall ones where they save a tower). Click on the line to add a tower, drag a tower to move it (release it off the line to remove it), right click to step back, then press the Build key. Esc closes the tool. Default Ctrl+Shift+L.
Builds the line the lift-line tool shows, with exactly the towers on screen. Only while the tool is open. In the cat track tool it grades and builds the track shown. Default Enter.

Opens or closes the cat track tool (the hub's Cat track tile): click points up the mountain, drag a point to move it, right click to step back, Enter to grade the ground and build the track. Default Ctrl+Shift+K.

Turns the cat track tool's delete mode on or off. In delete mode, click a cat track to select it and click it again to delete it (the ground stays graded, no refund). Right click or Esc leaves delete mode. Only while the tool is open; the hub Runs tab's Delete cat tracks chip does the same. Default Ctrl+Shift+D.

Opens or closes the Resort Planner (also a button on the hub's Runs tab): click the corners of a region, Enter to scan it, click a run to leave it out, Enter to build. Inert while the Resort Planner is off. Default Ctrl+Shift+Q.

Steps the tree density the glade tool brings a run to: 1 clears the run, each higher level holds more trees per hectare (felling or planting to reach it), 8 is a thick forest; after 8 it starts again at 1. Only while the glade tool is open. Default Shift+G.
Switches what the glade tool works on: the trees inside the run, or the tree line along its outside edge. Only while the glade tool is open. Default Alt+G.
Writes the drawing-feedback and glade-tool state to the mod log, also while a run is on the cursor. Needs Measurement diagnostics on. Default Ctrl+Alt+G.

SkiResort.GladeTooltip.BLOCKED: Trees cannot be planned on this run (see the mod log)
SkiResort.GladeTooltip.COMPLETE: Nothing to change: the run is already at this tree density
SkiResort.GladeTooltip.COMPLETE_BLOCKED: Nothing more can be planted: the remaining spots are blocked (roads, buildings)
SkiResort.GladeTooltip.COMPLETE_FIXED: Nothing to change: the remaining trees cannot be felled (other runs', buildings')
SkiResort.GladeTooltip.CLAMPED: Large run: apply again to continue
SkiResort.GladeTooltip.MONEY: Some trees canceled: not enough money?
SkiResort.Hub.TITLE: Ski Resort
SkiResort.Hub.NOT_CONNECTED: The mod is not answering: its hub system is missing or failed. See SkiResortMod.Mod.log.
SkiResort.Hub.STAMP_DIFFERS: The UI bundle comes from a different build than the DLL.
SkiResort.Hub.UI_ERROR: The Ski Resort panel hit an error and was closed. Details are in the mod log.
SkiResort.Hub.REASON[NoSign]: Place a Ski Area Welcome Sign first
SkiResort.Hub.REASON[Missing]: Asset not found: is the Modular Ski Resort asset pack installed?
SkiResort.Hub.REASON[AlreadyBuilt]: Already built at this ski area
SkiResort.Hub.HINT[LiftNoPair]: Place the other station first: a lift needs a base and a top station.
SkiResort.Hub.GLADE_REASON[Disabled]: The tree tool hit an error and is off until the next load. Details are in the mod log.
SkiResort.Hub.GLADE_REASON[NotInGame]: The tree tool works in a loaded city only.
SkiResort.Hub.GLADE_REASON[NoRuns]: The ski run assets were not found: is the asset pack installed?
SkiResort.Hub.GLADE_REASON[NoSpecies]: No tree species to plant were found.
SkiResort.Hub.SECTION_FAILED: This part of the panel failed. Details are in the mod log.
SkiResort.Hub.BUILD_EMPTY: No building tools were reported. See SkiResortMod.Mod.log.
SkiResort.Hub.BUILD_ACTIVE: In use: click again to stop
SkiResort.Hub.BUILD_HINT_LODGE: Guests start their ski day here: build it close to the runs.
SkiResort.Hub.TREES_UNAVAILABLE: The tree tool is not available right now.
SkiResort.Hub.RUNS_EMPTY: No runs yet. Pick a run type in the Runs tab below and draw its outline.
SkiResort.Hub.COL_LENGTH_TIP: Horizontal length, estimated from the outline.
SkiResort.Hub.COL_DROP_TIP: Approximate height from the lowest to the highest point of the outline.
SkiResort.Hub.LIFT_TOOL_TIP: Plan a lift line between two stations: Ctrl+Shift+L
SkiResort.Hub.LIFT_TOOL_TIP_ON: On: click a station, then the other station of the lift. Click again to stop.
SkiResort.Hub.LIFT_TOOL_UNAVAILABLE: Available once a city is loaded.
SkiResort.Hub.QUICK_TOOL_TIP: Outline a slope and get a set of runs to pick from. Experimental. Ctrl+Shift+Q also opens it.
SkiResort.Hub.QUICK_TOOL_TIP_ON: On: click the corners of a slope on the map. Click here to close the tool.
SkiResort.Hub.CAT_TRACK_DELETE_TIP: Opens the cat track tool in delete mode: click a track twice to delete it. The ground stays graded, no refund. Ctrl+Shift+D in the tool.
SkiResort.Hub.CAT_TRACK_DELETE_TIP_ON: On: click a cat track twice to delete it. Click here, right click or Esc to leave delete mode.
SkiResort.Hub.QUICK_REASON[Off]: Resort Planner is experimental and off. Turn it on in Options > Modular Ski Resort > Runs.
SkiResort.Hub.QUICK_REASON[NotArmed]: Available once a city is loaded.
SkiResort.Hub.QUICK_REASON[Disabled]: The Resort Planner hit an error and is off until the next load. Details are in the mod log.
SkiResort.Hub.QUICK_UNAVAILABLE: The Resort Planner is not available right now.
SkiResort.Hub.QUICK_SCAN_TIP: Scan the outlined slope for runs. Enter does the same.
SkiResort.Hub.QUICK_BUILD_TIP: Build every run that is not grayed out. Refused when the city cannot pay. Large areas can take a few seconds to a minute.
SkiResort.Hub.QUICK_UNDO_TIP: Remove the runs of the last build and refund what they cost. Only this button does it: right click never removes built runs.
SkiResort.Hub.QUICK_SHUFFLE_TIP: Try another layout of the same slope.
SkiResort.Hub.QUICK_MIX_TIP: Which colors the runs should be. Changing it picks again from the same scan.
SkiResort.Hub.QUICK_DENSITY_TIP: How many runs to fit on the slope.
SkiResort.Hub.QUICK_KINDS_TIP: Run kinds the tool may use. Click one to allow it or leave it out.
SkiResort.Hub.QUICK_START: Click the corners of a slope on the map, then Scan.
SkiResort.Hub.QUICK_REGION_LINE: {N} corners · {AREA} of {MAX} · vertical between the corners {V}
SkiResort.Hub.QUICK_REGION_OVER: The region is larger than the limit shown above: make it smaller.
SkiResort.Hub.QUICK_PREVIEW_HINT: Click a run on the map to leave it out or take it back.
SkiResort.Hub.QUICK_BUILDING: Building the runs. Large areas can take a few seconds to a minute.
SkiResort.Hub.QUICK_STOP_TIP: Stop after the part in progress. What is built or planted so far stays, and Undo removes it. Right click does the same.
SkiResort.Hub.QUICK_BATCH_LINE: Last build: {N} runs. Undo removes them and refunds the fee.
SkiResort.Hub.QUICK_TREES_TIP: Fill the outlined slope with trees up to the tree line, around the runs. Plant when it looks right.
SkiResort.Hub.QUICK_PLANT_TIP: Plant the trees, a few thousand at a time. Large areas can take a few seconds to a minute. Enter does the same.
SkiResort.Hub.QUICK_TREES_UNDO_TIP: Remove the trees of the last planting. Only this button does it: right click never removes planted trees.
SkiResort.Hub.QUICK_TREE_LINE_TIP: Trees grow up to this height. It starts where the wild trees nearby stop.
SkiResort.Hub.QUICK_GROUP_TIP: Which trees to plant: a group, or one species below.
SkiResort.Hub.QUICK_SPECIES_TIP: Step through single species. Step back past the first one for the whole group.
SkiResort.Tooltip.QUICK_PROMPT[Start]: Click the first corner of the slope you want runs on.
SkiResort.Tooltip.QUICK_PROMPT[Corners]: Keep clicking corners. Three or more make a region.
SkiResort.Tooltip.QUICK_PROMPT[Ready]: Press Enter to scan the region. Drag a corner to reshape it.
SkiResort.Tooltip.QUICK_PROMPT[Drag]: Drag the corner and release it to place it.
SkiResort.Tooltip.QUICK_PROMPT[Preview]: Click a run to leave it out or take it back. Enter builds; right click leaves the preview.
SkiResort.Tooltip.QUICK_PROMPT[Building]: Building the runs. Large areas can take a few seconds to a minute. Right click stops; what is built stays.
SkiResort.Tooltip.QUICK_PROMPT[Planting]: Planting the trees. Large areas can take a few seconds to a minute. Right click stops; what is planted stays.
SkiResort.Tooltip.QUICK_PROMPT[Built]: Built. Undo in the Ski Resort panel removes this build and refunds its fee; right click does not.
SkiResort.Tooltip.QUICK_PROMPT[Trees]: Tree filler: pick the tree line and species in the hub. Enter plants.
SkiResort.Tooltip.QUICK_MIX: Green {G} of {TG} · Blue {B} of {TB} · Black {K} of {TK} · Double black {D} of {TD}
SkiResort.Tooltip.QUICK_SITE[Gentle]: Gentle slope (average {N} %): good for green and blue runs.
SkiResort.Tooltip.QUICK_SITE[Steep]: Steep slope (average {N} %): mostly blue and black runs. Greens need the gentlest parts.
SkiResort.Tooltip.QUICK_SITE[VerySteep]: Very steep (average {N} %): mostly black runs, few or no greens. Gentler ground lower down suits beginners.
SkiResort.Tooltip.QUICK_SITE[Beyond]: Steeper than any real ski area (average {N} %): expect black and double black runs only. Look for gentler ground lower down for beginners.
SkiResort.Tooltip.QUICK_STATUS[BadInput]: The region could not be read. Draw it again.
SkiResort.Tooltip.QUICK_STATUS[TooLarge]: The region is over the size limit shown beside it. Make it smaller.
SkiResort.Tooltip.QUICK_STATUS[TooSmall]: The region is too small for a run. Make it larger.
SkiResort.Tooltip.QUICK_STATUS[TooNarrow: The region is too narrow: a run needs open slope about 70 m across, clear of other areas. Make it wider.
SkiResort.Tooltip.QUICK_STATUS[Blocked]: Most of the region is taken by other areas or by land the city does not own.
SkiResort.Tooltip.QUICK_STATUS[NoVertica: The region has too little vertical for ski runs.
SkiResort.Tooltip.QUICK_STATUS[AllCliff]: The region is mostly cliff: no run can reach the bottom. Try a gentler slope.
SkiResort.Tooltip.QUICK_STATUS[TooFlat]: The region is too flat for ski runs.
SkiResort.Tooltip.QUICK_STATUS[NoRuns]: No run fits this region. Try another shape or another mix.
SkiResort.Tooltip.QUICK_WARN[NoGreen]: No green runs: the slope is too steep for them, or the gentle part at the bottom is too short.
SkiResort.Tooltip.QUICK_WARN[NoBlue]: No blue runs: the slope gives none.
SkiResort.Tooltip.QUICK_WARN[NoBlack]: No black runs: the slope is too gentle for them.
SkiResort.Tooltip.QUICK_WARN[NoEasyWayHo: A lift top here has no green way down.
SkiResort.Tooltip.QUICK_WARN[NoFlatRunou: No gentle runout at the bottom of the slope.
SkiResort.Tooltip.QUICK_WARN[MixShort]: Fewer runs of some colors than the mix asks for.
SkiResort.Tooltip.QUICK_WARN[CrossesCatT: A run crosses a cat track.
SkiResort.Tooltip.QUICK_WARN[PartlyBlock: Part of the region is blocked by other areas or by land the city does not own.
SkiResort.Tooltip.QUICK_WARN[MoneyShort]: The city cannot pay the total fee: building is refused.
SkiResort.Tooltip.QUICK_WARN[Renumber]: Runs with default names will be renumbered.
SkiResort.Tooltip.QUICK_WARN[OtherResort: These runs belong to more than one ski area.
SkiResort.Tooltip.QUICK_WARN[NoSign]: No Welcome Sign within 5 km: the runs will not count until one is placed nearby.
SkiResort.Tooltip.QUICK_WARN[ChecksOff]: The game's own checks are off (Anarchy): only this tool's checks protect the build.
SkiResort.Tooltip.QUICK_NEED_CORNERS: Click at least three corners first.
SkiResort.Tooltip.QUICK_RESCANNED: The map changed since the scan: scanned again. Check the preview and build again.
SkiResort.Tooltip.QUICK_NOTHING_ENABLED: Every run is left out: click a run to take it back.
SkiResort.Tooltip.QUICK_DROPPED: The game refused some runs: they are red and left out. Building the rest.
SkiResort.Tooltip.QUICK_REFUSED: Nothing was built: the game refused the red runs. Build again to try the rest.
SkiResort.Tooltip.QUICK_STOPPED: Build stopped. The runs built so far stay; Undo removes them.
SkiResort.Tooltip.QUICK_PARTIAL: Only part of the runs were built: the game refused the rest. Undo removes what was built.
SkiResort.Tooltip.QUICK_UNDONE: The build was undone and its fee refunded.
SkiResort.Tooltip.QUICK_RUNS_MISSING: The ski run assets did not load: check that the mod is installed completely.
SkiResort.Tooltip.QUICK_TREES_OFF: Turn the tree filler on first.
SkiResort.Tooltip.QUICK_TREES_COMPLETE: Nothing to plant: the slope already has this many trees.
SkiResort.Tooltip.QUICK_TREES_BLOCKED: The game refuses some of these trees: planting stopped. Trees planted before stay.
SkiResort.Tooltip.QUICK_TREES_STOPPED: Planting stopped. The trees planted so far stay; Undo trees removes them.
SkiResort.Tooltip.QUICK_NO_SPECIES: No tree species of this kind were found.
SkiResort.Hub.RESORT_TIP: Click to pick the ski area the panel shows.
SkiResort.Hub.RESORT_MENU_NOTE: Selecting a sign, a lodge or a station on the map shows its ski area here.
SkiResort.Hub.UNLINKED_ENTRY: Not linked to a ski area
SkiResort.Hub.UNLINKED_HINT: More than 5 km from every Welcome Sign. Place a sign nearby to link them.
SkiResort.Hub.RENAME_TIP: Enter or a click elsewhere keeps the name. Esc cancels. An empty name restores the default.
SkiResort.Hub.RUN_DELETE_TIP: Click, then click again to delete. The ground stays graded and the fee is not refunded.
SkiResort.Hub.RUN_DELETE_CONFIRM: Click again to delete this cat track.
SkiResort.Hub.UNRATEABLE: Cannot be rated: outline too large or too thin, or no terrain under it
SkiResort.Hub.DETAIL[Share]: Share of the city's tourist draw
SkiResort.Hub.EST_TOURISTS_TIP: An estimate from the game's tourist formula. Tourism mods can replace the formula, so real arrivals can differ.
SkiResort.Hub.LIFTS_EMPTY: No lifts yet. Place a base station and a top station facing each other, then draw the lift line between them.
SkiResort.Hub.LIFT_TOWER_REMOVED: A tower was removed by another tool. Redraw a section next to it to restore it.
SkiResort.Hub.LIFT_NAME_TIP: The name is stored on the base station, or on the top station while there is no base.
SkiResort.Hub.LIFT_SIGN_TIP: A lift belongs to the ski area of its base station; a run keeps the ski area it was drawn for.
SkiResort.Hub.BUILD_HINT_SIGN: Starts a ski area: the runs and lifts within 5 km belong to it. Snap it to a road; it stands set back from it.
SkiResort.Hub.BUILD_HINT_BASE: Place at the bottom of the lift.
SkiResort.Hub.BUILD_HINT_TOP: Place at the top, facing the base station. A guide shows when it is straight.
SkiResort.Hub.BUILD_HINT_LIFT: Draw from station to station. On steep ground, redraw one section at a time.
SkiResort.Hub.CONTRACT_MISMATCH_CORE: This panel (version {UI}) and the mod's DLL (version {DLL}) come from different builds. Building still works; the resort statistics are hidden until the mod is reinstalled.
SkiResort.Hub.START_STEP[2]: Connect the sign to a road
SkiResort.Hub.START_STEP[3]: Build a lodge near the runs
SkiResort.Hub.START_STEP[4]: Build a lift: two stations, then the line
SkiResort.Hub.START_STEP[5]: Draw runs from the top of the lift
SkiResort.Hub.STATUS_TIP_RULE: Open: enough snow on 60 % of the run. Closed: under 40 %. Patchy: in between.
SkiResort.Hub.STATUS_TIP_ESTIMATED: Some runs are estimated from the day's temperature until their snow can be measured.
SkiResort.Hub.STATUS_TIP_GATING: Snow & season gating is off in Options, so every run counts as open.
SkiResort.Hub.STATUS_TIP_VISUALS: Snow is hidden in your Gameplay settings. Runs still open on the simulated snow.
SkiResort.Hub.PROBLEM[Unlinked]: More than 5 km from every Welcome Sign
SkiResort.Hub.PROBLEM[SignNoRoad]: Welcome Sign is not at a road
SkiResort.Hub.PROBLEM[LodgeNoRoad]: Lodge or school is not at a road
SkiResort.Hub.PROBLEM[SkiDaysCannotReach: Many ski-day guests with a car never arrive
SkiResort.Hub.PROBLEM[LodgeNotSlopeside]: Lodge is far from the runs
SkiResort.Hub.PROBLEM[SchoolNoGreenRun]: Ski school has no green run
SkiResort.Hub.PROBLEM_TIP[NoLodge]: Guests arrive at a lodge. Build one from the Buildings tab.
SkiResort.Hub.PROBLEM_TIP[LodgesAllOff]: Switched-off lodges do not count. Switch one on in its info panel.
SkiResort.Hub.PROBLEM_TIP[LodgesSomeOff]: Switched-off lodges do not count in the lodge base.
SkiResort.Hub.PROBLEM_TIP[Efficiency]: As in the Welcome Sign's info panel. Every cause that costs 5 % or more is listed below.
SkiResort.Hub.PROBLEM_TIP[LiftNoPower]: Its base station has no electricity, so the lift stops and serves no run. Maintenance is still charged. Connect a low-voltage line.
SkiResort.Hub.PROBLEM_TIP[LiftSectionMis: A section was removed or is being redrawn. Until the line is complete the lift counts 0 and costs a quarter.
SkiResort.Hub.PROBLEM_TIP[LiftUnfinished: The line does not join a base station and a top station yet.
SkiResort.Hub.PROBLEM_TIP[NoRuns]: Pick a run type in the Runs tab and draw its outline.
SkiResort.Hub.PROBLEM_TIP[Stations]: A station is placed, but no line joins it to its partner yet.
SkiResort.Hub.PROBLEM_TIP[LiftChairsStop: The lift is complete and still counts, but its chairs stopped. The mod log says why.
SkiResort.Hub.PROBLEM_TIP[RunsUnrateable: The outline is too large or too thin, or has no terrain under it. These runs count very little.
SkiResort.Hub.PROBLEM_TIP[RunsRating]: Runs are rated one at a time. A new run counts 0 until it is rated; a reshaped run keeps its last rating.
SkiResort.Hub.PROBLEM_TIP[FreeLodges]: They are more than 5 km from every Welcome Sign, so they count nowhere. Place a sign nearby or move them.
SkiResort.Hub.PROBLEM_TIP[SignNoRoad]: Snap its front to a road: staff and visitors enter from it. It stands set back already; for an angle, use the angled sign.
SkiResort.Hub.PROBLEM_TIP[LodgeNoRoad]: Move it so its entrance side touches a road.
SkiResort.Hub.PROBLEM_TIP[SchoolsNotLink: More than 5 km from every Welcome Sign, so they teach nobody. Place a sign nearby or move the school.
SkiResort.Hub.PROBLEM_TIP[SkiDaysCannotR: Many recent ski-day guests with a car did not reach the lodge in time. Fewer are sent until more arrive.
SkiResort.Hub.PROBLEM_TIP[NoParkingNearL: No car spaces within 300 m of the lodge. Guests who drive need a parking lot or a street with parking.
SkiResort.Hub.PROBLEM_TIP[LodgeNotSlopes: Ski-day guests only go to a lodge within 800 m of this ski area's runs or lift stations.
SkiResort.Hub.PROBLEM_TIP[MixedLiftTypes: A line and its stations must be one lift type; until then the lift counts 0. Redraw the line as the stations' type.
SkiResort.Hub.PROBLEM_TIP[SummitLodgeNot: In summer a summit lodge counts more only within 300 m of a working lift's top station.
SkiResort.Hub.PROBLEM_TIP[SchoolNoGreenR: The ski school adds to the score only while a green run counts.
SkiResort.Hub.TILE_TIP[Attraction]: The ski area's score on the attraction scale: a park is about 10, a landmark about 120. Lodges share it; their panels show 0.
SkiResort.Hub.TILE_TIP_HELD: Checking runs and snow after loading. The game keeps the saved score meanwhile.
SkiResort.Hub.TILE_TIP[Runs]: Runs fully open now, out of all runs in this ski area.
SkiResort.Hub.TILE_TIP[Lifts]: Complete lifts out of every lift drawn, unfinished ones included. Without power a complete lift stops and adds nothing.
SkiResort.Hub.TILE_TIP[Guests]: Month of {MONTH}: tourists who arrived at the lodges or the Welcome Sign, and residents who visited a lodge.
SkiResort.Hub.TILE_TIP_SINCE_LOAD: Counted since you loaded the city.
SkiResort.Hub.TILE_TIP[Money]: Net of the month so far: all resort income booked, minus lifts, runs, buildings and wages. The Finances view's Net.
SkiResort.Hub.TILE_TIP_EST: ≈ Some income or costs are not counted yet; they read as 0.
SkiResort.Hub.TILE_TIP_EST_BUILDINGS: ≈ The game's bill for buildings and wages is not known yet.
SkiResort.Hub.RECEIPT[LodgeBaseHalf]: Lodge base, half until a run counts
SkiResort.Hub.RECEIPT_TIP[LodgeBase]: Best lodge's base plus the others' extras, up to 24 more. Half while no run counts, more for a summit lodge a lift reaches.
SkiResort.Hub.RECEIPT_TIP[Runs]: Each run's value now, from its difficulty, size, type, lift and snow. The Runs view lists them.
SkiResort.Hub.RECEIPT_TIP[Lifts]: Each complete lift with power adds fixed-grip 6, detachable 15, gondola 25. While no run counts, chairlifts and gondolas add a quarter.
SkiResort.Hub.RECEIPT_TIP[School]: A ski school adds its value while a green run counts.
SkiResort.Hub.RECEIPT_TIP[Variety]: × 1.15 while a green, a blue and a black or harder run all count, else × 1.
SkiResort.Hub.RECEIPT_TIP[Scale]: The section total is this scale × the square root of the terms above. Attractiveness scale in Options.
SkiResort.Hub.RECEIPT_TIP[Efficiency]: As in the Welcome Sign's info panel: staff, power, water, sewage, garbage, budget and more. The score uses the day's average, at most 100 %.
SkiResort.Hub.RECEIPT_TIP[Result]: (Lodge base + runs, lifts and school) × efficiency, at most 200. The active lodges share it; their own panels show 0.
SkiResort.Hub.SHARE_TIP: This ski area's share of the city's attraction, the game's way: each building's score squared. The tourists it draws visit the whole city.
SkiResort.Hub.MOUNTAIN_TIP[Vertical]: From the lowest run bottom to the highest run top. ≈ while runs are being rated.
SkiResort.Hub.AREA_TIP: The plan area of all runs in this ski area.
SkiResort.Hub.MOUNTAIN_TIP[Depth]: Average snow depth on the runs.
SkiResort.Hub.MOUNTAIN_TIP[Snow]: Share of the run area with enough snow to ski.
SkiResort.Hub.UNLINKED_NOTE: These runs and lifts belong to no ski area, so they score nothing and draw no guests.
SkiResort.Hub.TREE_TOOL_TIP: Plans trees on and around runs. Turn it on, point at a run and click.
SkiResort.Hub.TREE_TOOL_TIP_ON: The tree tool is on. Click to turn it off.
SkiResort.Hub.PISTE_MAP_TIP: Draws this ski area's runs on the ground in difficulty colors while the panel is open. Natural: dashed. Too flat: gray. Cannot be rated: orange.
SkiResort.Hub.COL_LIFT_TIP: ↑: a running lift reaches the top of this run.
SkiResort.Hub.RUN_GUNS[DepthReached]: Snow guns: off, the snow is deep enough
SkiResort.Hub.RUN_GUNS[OutOfSeason]: Snow guns: off, out of season (October–March)
SkiResort.Hub.RUN_GUNS[Waiting]: Snow guns: waiting for the first snow reading
SkiResort.Hub.RUN_OPEN_GATING: Counts as open: snow rules are off.
SkiResort.Hub.RUN_SERVED_ANON: A running lift reaches its top.
SkiResort.Hub.RUN_TYPE_NOTE: Natural green and blue runs count less; a groomed run counts in full.
SkiResort.Hub.RUN_CAT_TRACK_NOTE: A cat track always rates green and counts a quarter of a run its size, in the score and the capacity.
SkiResort.Hub.RUN_ACTIONS: Click to fly there. The pen renames it.
SkiResort.Hub.LIFT_LINE2[SectionMissing]: Redraw the gap with the lift line tool
SkiResort.Hub.LIFT_LINE2[Unfinished]: Not connected to a station at both ends yet
SkiResort.Hub.LIFT_LINE2[StationsPair]: Both stations placed: draw the lift line between them
SkiResort.Hub.LIFT_LINE2[StationsBaseOnl: Base station placed: place the top station facing it
SkiResort.Hub.LIFT_LINE2[StationsTopOnly: Top station placed: place the base station facing it
SkiResort.Hub.LIFT_RIDE_TIP: Base to top at {SPEED} m/s line speed, at 1× game speed.
SkiResort.Hub.LIFT_CAPACITY_TIP: {SEATS} seats per carrier at {SPEED} m/s; a tram counts its station stops. None without power or an open run. Riders are not simulated.
SkiResort.Hub.LIFTS_TOTAL_CAPACITY_TIP: Sum over complete lifts with power and an open run; a tram counts its station stops. Riders are not simulated.
SkiResort.Hub.LIFT_COST_REDUCED[NoPower]: Billed reduced: no open run in its ski area (a quarter; a tram half)
SkiResort.Hub.LIFT_COST_REDUCED[Unfinish: Billed at a quarter while unfinished
SkiResort.Hub.LIFT_COST_REDUCED[SectionM: Billed at a quarter while a section is missing
SkiResort.Hub.LIFT_COST_REDUCED[NoOpenRu: Billed reduced: no open run in its ski area (a quarter; a tram half)
SkiResort.Hub.LIFT_ACTIONS: Click to fly there (to the gap if a section is missing). The pen renames it.
SkiResort.Hub.GUESTS_TIP[SkiDays]: Skiers the resort sends out on a ski day, counted when they reach a lodge. They also count as residents or tourists.
SkiResort.Hub.GUESTS_TIP[Tourists]: People in tourist groups that arrived at this ski area's lodges or Welcome Sign.
SkiResort.Hub.GUESTS_TIP[Groups]: Tourists arrive in groups; each group counts once.
SkiResort.Hub.GUESTS_TIP[Residents]: Residents of your city who came to a lodge for leisure.
SkiResort.Hub.GUESTS_TIP[Tickets]: Paid by each guest's household into your city's balance.
SkiResort.Hub.GUESTS_LAST_NA: Not counted: counting starts when the city loads.
SkiResort.Hub.GUESTS_LAST_PARTIAL: Not counted in full: the city was loaded, or time skipped ahead, during that month.
SkiResort.Hub.SKI_DAYS[Off]: Ski days are off in Options
SkiResort.Hub.SKI_DAYS[SignOff]: Closed: the Welcome Sign is not running
SkiResort.Hub.SKI_DAYS_TIP[Off]: Locals who ski and Tourists who ski are both 0 in Options.
SkiResort.Hub.SKI_DAYS_TIP[NoLodge]: Ski days need a lodge that is switched on, at a road, and within 800 m of the runs.
SkiResort.Hub.SKI_DAYS_TIP[Runs]: The runs set the limit: bigger and easier runs hold more skiers at once.
SkiResort.Hub.SKI_DAYS_TIP[Lodges]: The lodges set the limit: each lodge takes 360 skiers at once, more on a powder day.
SkiResort.Hub.EST_ROW[Tourists]: Estimated tourists from this ski area
SkiResort.Hub.EST_TO_NOTE: Detected: Tourism Overhaul. It sets tourist numbers.
SkiResort.Hub.EST_TO_TIP: Tourism Overhaul sets tourist numbers in this city, so no estimate is shown.
SkiResort.Hub.TRIP_PLANNER_NOTE[Unknown]: Part of the game's trip planner is switched off (another mod, or a game error), so trip times can differ.
SkiResort.Hub.TRIP_PLANNER_NOTE[UnknownO: Ski days off: the game's leisure systems are switched off (another mod, or a game error).
SkiResort.Hub.TRIP_PLANNER_TIP: Read at each city load: which of the game's trip systems are on, and which known mods are loaded. The mod log lists them.
SkiResort.Hub.GUESTS_NOTE[Where]: Counted when tourists arrive at this ski area's lodge or Welcome Sign, and when residents come to a lodge for leisure.
SkiResort.Hub.GUESTS_NOTE[SinceLoad]: Counting started when you loaded the city, partway through the month.
SkiResort.Hub.TICKETS_NOTE[Off]: Lift tickets are off: the Lift ticket price in Options is 0.
SkiResort.Hub.TICKETS_NOTE[NoEfficiency]: No lift tickets now: the Welcome Sign is not running.
SkiResort.Hub.TICKETS_NOTE[NothingOpen]: No lift tickets now: no run is open. Off-season, lodges drop to half staff (Options); set one Inactive: a tenth of upkeep, no wages.
SkiResort.Hub.TICKETS_NOTE[NotKnownYet]: No lift tickets yet: runs are being checked after a load or a new sign.
SkiResort.Hub.MONEY_TICKETS_TIP: Booked this month so far: each guest who paid × the price when they arrived.
SkiResort.Hub.MONEY_TIP[RunsBooked]: Run upkeep booked this month so far. Today's rate per month, by kind:
SkiResort.Hub.MONEY_TIP[Net]: All income booked this month minus all costs: the rows above add up to it. Buildings and wages: today's rate × the month so far.
SkiResort.Hub.MONEY_NOTE[Panel]: This month so far: income, lift and run costs as booked; buildings and wages at today's rate for the share of the month gone.
SkiResort.Hub.MONEY_NOTE[Rwh]: Detected: Realistic Workplaces. The real bill can differ.
SkiResort.Hub.MONEY_TIP[Rwh]: Realistic Workplaces And Households changes staff costs; the bill can differ.
SkiResort.Hub.MONEY_NOTE[Est]: ≈ Some income or costs are not counted yet; they read as 0 in the net.
SkiResort.Hub.MONEY_PRICE_TIP[Where]: Options > Modular Ski Resort > Main > Ski area balance. One price for every ski area.
SkiResort.Hub.MONEY_PRICE_TIP[Who]: Only ski days react to it; other visitors and the attraction score ignore it.
SkiResort.Hub.MONEY_ROW[PassesPre]: Season passes sold before the season · {N}
SkiResort.Hub.MONEY_TIP[Lessons]: Booked this month so far, one lesson per guest. Share and price: Options > Modular Ski Resort > Main > Ski area balance.
SkiResort.Hub.MONEY_TIP[PassesPre]: The one sale before the season opens. Part of the season's sales; in the net in the month it sold.
SkiResort.Hub.MONEY_TIP[CityIncome]: Estimate: this ski area's share of the city's tourist draw × the game's tourist income. City income, outside the net.
SkiResort.Hub.GUESTS_TIP[Lessons]: Guests who took a lesson, one each.
SkiResort.Hub.MONEY_TIP[Passes]: Sold July to June. Holders ski free all season and come more often. Share and price: Options > Modular Ski Resort > Main > Ski area balance.
SkiResort.Hub.MONEY_TIP[PassHolders]: Guests who came in on a season pass: no lift ticket money now.
SkiResort.Hub.GUESTS_ROW[PassHolders]: Came in on a season pass
SkiResort.Hub.GUESTS_TIP[PassHolders]: Residents who came in on a season pass. They paid once for the season and pay nothing at the gate. Tourists never hold one.
SkiResort.Hub.MONEY_TIP[LodgeSpend]: Booked this month so far: paying ski guests' spend at the lodges. Set per guest in Options > Modular Ski Resort > Main > Ski area balance.
SkiResort.Hub.UNLINKED_MONEY: Runs and lifts that are not linked earn nothing. Their running costs are still charged.
SkiResort.Hub.BUILD_SHORT[Lodge]: Build it close to the runs.
SkiResort.Hub.BUILD_SHORT[Top]: Place at the top, facing the base station.
SkiResort.Hub.BUILD_SHORT[Lift]: Draw from station to station, one section at a time.
SkiResort.Hub.BUILD_TIP_SCHOOL: Adds +12 to Runs, lifts and school while a green run counts; locals come 20 % more often.
SkiResort.Hub.BUILD_TIP_PATROL: Black and double-black runs within 1 km score 15 % more; runs there without a lift count at least 70 %.
SkiResort.Hub.BUILD_TIP_LUXURY: Luxury lodge. Ski days stay full at a lift ticket price up to 40 higher.
SkiResort.Hub.PICKER_TIP[LiftType]: Pick the kind of lift to build.
SkiResort.Hub.BUILD_TAB_TIP[Lifts]: Lifts: build the two stations, then the line. Pick the lift type below.
SkiResort.Hub.BUILD_TAB_TIP[Runs]: Runs: draw a run from the top of a lift, or plan trees with the tree tool.
SkiResort.Hub.BUILD_TAB_TIP[Buildings]: Buildings: the Welcome Sign, lodges, the ski school and ski patrol.
SkiResort.Hub.BUILD_HINT_FENCE: Draw it like a path to fence off a slope, mark a run edge or close a run.
SkiResort.Hub.BUILD_MONTH_STATION: The whole lift is priced by its length: both stations and the line. This station is one part.
SkiResort.Hub.BUILD_TIP_RESHAPE: Reshaping a run later costs nothing more.
SkiResort.Hub.BUILD_TIP_NATURAL: Nothing is drawn on the ground: find it with the piste map.
SkiResort.Hub.BUILD_TIP_TYPE[Natural]: Score: greens count half, blues three quarters, blacks in full. It opens only when natural snow covers it.
SkiResort.Hub.STATUS_TIP_TEMP: Day average at the top of the highest run: {TEMP}
SkiResort.Hub.STATUS_TIP_POWDER: Fresh snow at the top: powder {PCT}. More skiers come.
SkiResort.Hub.PROBLEM[NotRunningMore]: Welcome Sign not running: {REASON} and {N} more
SkiResort.Hub.PROBLEM[FreeLodges]: Lodges not linked to a ski area: {N}
SkiResort.Hub.PROBLEM[SchoolsNotLinked]: Ski schools not linked to a ski area: {N}
SkiResort.Hub.PROBLEM_TIP[NoLift]: A run counts {PCT} until a running lift reaches its top: within 150 m of the line, at most 15 m above the top station.
SkiResort.Hub.PROBLEM_TIP[RunsUnserved]: Each counts {PCT} until a running lift reaches its top: within 150 m of the line, at most 15 m above the top station.
SkiResort.Hub.PROBLEM_GAIN[Efficiency]: At full efficiency the attraction would be {FULL}.
SkiResort.Hub.PROBLEM_GAIN[Lodge]: With a lodge, the attraction would be {A}.
SkiResort.Hub.PROBLEM_GAIN[LodgesOn]: With them switched on, the attraction would be {A}.
SkiResort.Hub.SCORE_BAR_TIP: {NOW} now, {FULL} at full efficiency, out of 200.
SkiResort.Hub.RECEIPT_TIP[Terrain]: {K} is the Attractiveness scale in Options. Adding a run never lowers the total.
SkiResort.Hub.RECEIPT_ROOT: {K} × the square root of the line above = {TERRAIN}
SkiResort.Hub.RECEIPT_TIP[Vertical]: From × 1 at 0 m to × 2 at 600 m or more. Now {M}, lowest bottom to highest top of the runs that count.
SkiResort.Hub.RECEIPT_OPEN: Runs open now: {PCT} of their full value
SkiResort.Hub.RECEIPT_TIP[Open]: Closed runs add nothing and patchy runs add part, so snow moves the score. With every run fully open, runs would add {FULL}.
SkiResort.Hub.RUN_NOT_SERVED: No running lift reaches its top: it counts {PCT}
SkiResort.Hub.LIFT_DETAIL_NONE: {LENGTH} · rise {RISE} · {MIN} min ride · {CAP} skiers/h · no runs
SkiResort.Hub.GUESTS_TIP[Paid]: Month of {MONTH}: {GUESTS} guests, {PAID} paid, {HOLDERS} on a pass, {UNPAID} could not pay, {FREE} free while tickets were off or closed.
SkiResort.Hub.TICKETS_NOTE[Open]: Each guest without a season pass pays {PRICE} on arrival. Set the price in Options.
SkiResort.Hub.TRIP_PLANNER_NOTE[Known]: Detected: {NAME}. It replaces the game's trip planner, so trip times can differ.
SkiResort.Hub.TRIP_PLANNER_NOTE[KnownOff: Ski days off: {NAME} replaced the game's leisure systems.
SkiResort.Hub.SKI_DAYS[RoomRuns]: Holds {N} skiers at once, set by the runs
SkiResort.Hub.SKI_DAYS[RoomLodges]: Holds {N} skiers at once, set by the lodges
SkiResort.Hub.SKI_DAYS_TIP[Sent]: Month of {MONTH}: {SENT} sent, {ARRIVED} reached a lodge
SkiResort.Hub.SKI_DAYS_TIP[Split]: Close by {WALK} · by car {CAR} · far, no car {FAR}
SkiResort.Hub.SKI_DAYS_TIP[Now]: On the hill or on the way now: {NOW} of {CAP}
SkiResort.Hub.MONEY_TIP[PassesMonth]: Sold this month so far, in the net now. Of it, the pre-season sale: {PRE}.
SkiResort.Hub.MONEY_TIP[LiftsRate]: Booked this month so far. At today's rate: {RATE} per month.
SkiResort.Hub.MONEY_TIP[SoFar]: {RATE} per month at today's budget; {SHARE} of the month so far.
SkiResort.Hub.MONEY_PRICE_TIP[Curve]: Ski days: as many at any price up to {FULL}, then fewer: {F1} as many at {P1}, {F2} at {P2}, {F3} at {P3}.
SkiResort.Hub.MONEY_PRICE_TIP[Tolerance]: This ski area's lodges keep ski days full up to {FULL}.
SkiResort.Hub.MONEY_TIP[Lifts]: {BASE} per month per lift + {PERKM} per km of line, in full even without power; a quarter while unfinished or with no open run (a tram half). Now {FULL} full, {REDUCED} reduced.
SkiResort.Hub.MONEY_TIP[LiftsTypes]: Each lift: its kind's base per month + a rate per km of line, in full even without power; a quarter while unfinished or with no open run (a tram half). Now {FULL} full, {REDUCED} reduced.
SkiResort.Hub.MONEY_TIP[Buildings]: Upkeep {UPKEEP} · wages {WAGES} for {FILLED} of {JOBS} staff, at the Parks & Recreation budget.
SkiResort.Hub.BUILD_MONTH_LIFT: {BASE} per complete lift + {PERKM} per km of line
SkiResort.Hub.TILE_TIP[History]: Guests and finances of every month this ski area has recorded.
SkiResort.Hub.HISTORY_TIP[Scope]: Whole city adds every ski area that exists now; a deleted one's history goes with it. No attraction line: each area has its own.
SkiResort.Hub.HISTORY_TIP[Range12]: The last 12 months. The month in progress is the last bar.
SkiResort.Hub.HISTORY_TIP[RangeSeasons]: This ski season, July to June, in color. Last season's same months in gray behind it.
SkiResort.Hub.HISTORY_TIP[RangeBySeason]: One bar per ski season, July to June: the average month, so a season with missing months compares fairly.
SkiResort.Hub.HISTORY_TIP[Attraction]: The attraction score and the snow when each month closed. A season shows its averages.
SkiResort.Hub.HISTORY[Empty]: No month recorded yet. The first one closes at the end of this month.
SkiResort.Hub.HISTORY[Unlinked]: Not linked keeps no history. Whole city shows every ski area.
SkiResort.Hub.HISTORY[Partial]: Partial: counted for part of the month only
SkiResort.Hub.HISTORY[PartialSeason]: Partial: some months are missing or partial
SkiResort.Hub.HISTORY_TIP[Yoy]: The last whole month against the same month a year earlier.
SkiResort.Hub.HISTORY_TIP[Staff]: The game's bill for buildings and wages, at the rate when the month closed.
SkiResort.Hub.HISTORY_TIP[Chart]: Point at a bar for its numbers. Faded bars are partial months; hatched slots recorded nothing.
SkiResort.Hub.SEASON_TIP[SnowSeason]: At or below freezing: natural snow can fall.
SkiResort.Hub.SEASON_TIP[SnowGunsOnly]: Above freezing, but the snow guns are running.
SkiResort.Hub.SEASON_TIP[Thawing]: Above freezing and no snow gun running. Runs stay open on the snow that is left.
SkiResort.Hub.SEASON_TIP[WaitingForSnow]: Cold enough for snow or snow guns, but no run has enough snow yet.
SkiResort.Hub.SEASON_TIP[TooWarm]: Too warm for snow guns. Runs reopen when it cools, or turn off Snow & season gating in Options.
SkiResort.Hub.BUILD_SHORT[Groomed]: Snow laid whenever it freezes; scores more on easy runs.
SkiResort.Hub.BUILD_SHORT[Snowmaking]: Snow guns open it earlier and keep it open longer.
SkiResort.Hub.BUILD_SHORT[Natural]: Natural snow only, no running cost; easy runs score less.
SkiResort.Hub.BUILD_SHORT[CatTrack]: Graded as you lay it out; always green, counts a quarter.
SkiResort.Hub.NEXT[Sign]: Next: place a Ski Area Welcome Sign from the Buildings tab.
SkiResort.Hub.NEXT[Unlinked]: Runs and lifts link to the nearest Welcome Sign within 5 km.
SkiResort.Hub.NEXT[Lodge]: Next: build a lodge from the Buildings tab.
SkiResort.Hub.NEXT[Lift]: Next: in the Lifts tab, a base station, a top station, then the line.
SkiResort.Hub.NEXT[Run]: Next: draw a run from the Runs tab.
SkiResort.Hub.NEXT[Done]: Point at a tile to see its cost and what it does.
SkiResort.Hub.NEXT2[Unlinked]: Place a sign near them to link them.
SkiResort.Hub.NEXT2[Lodge]: Guests arrive at a lodge. Without one the attraction is 0.
SkiResort.Hub.NEXT2[Lift]: Runs that a lift serves count in full.
SkiResort.Hub.NEXT2[Run]: Natural runs cost nothing to run; the others cost per hectare.
SkiResort.Hub.NEXT2[Done]: Click a tile to build; click it again to stop.
SkiResort.LiftTooltip.ALIGN_NO_PARTNER: No free station of the other kind within 3 km
SkiResort.LiftTooltip.ALIGN_FACING_AWAY: Facing away from the other station: turn it around
SkiResort.LiftTooltip.ALIGN_PARTNER_AWAY: The other station faces away from this one
SkiResort.LiftTooltip.BULLDOZE_SECTION: Removes 1 lift section. The lift stops until you redraw it.
SkiResort.LiftTooltip.BULLDOZE_TOWER: This is a tower: it removes every section attached to it. Click the cable to remove one section.
SkiResort.LiftTooltip.BULLDOZE_SECTIONS: Removes these lift sections. The lift stops until you redraw them.
SkiResort.LiftTooltip.BULLDOZE_STUB: Also removes the station's connection stub
SkiResort.PowerJoin.REFUSED: A power line cannot connect to a ski lift.
SkiResort.LiftTool.PICK_FIRST_ANY: Click a lift station or the loose end of a lift line to start. Right click closes the tool.
SkiResort.LiftTool.PICK_FIRST: {TYPE} line: click a station, a loose line end or open ground to start. Right click closes the tool.
SkiResort.LiftTool.PICK_SECOND: {TYPE} line: now click the other end. Right click goes back a step.
SkiResort.LiftTool.EDIT: Click the line to add a tower. Drag a tower to move it. Enter builds, right click undoes, Esc closes.
SkiResort.LiftTool.DRAG: Release to place the tower here. Release away from the line to remove it. Right click cancels the move.
SkiResort.LiftTool.DRAG_OFF: Release here to remove this tower, or move back onto the line to keep it.
SkiResort.LiftTool.PLAN_CLEAR: Towers: {TOWERS}, length {LENGTH} m. The line is ready to build.
SkiResort.LiftTool.PLAN_LOW: Towers: {TOWERS}, length {LENGTH} m. The red part hangs too close to the ground: add a tower or move one.
SkiResort.LiftTool.PLAN_HIGH: Towers: {TOWERS}, length {LENGTH} m. The purple part runs too high above the ground: add a tower under it.
SkiResort.LiftTool.PLAN_STEEP: Towers: {TOWERS}, length {LENGTH} m. The red part is too steep for this lift: move the tower beside it, or pick flatter ends.
SkiResort.LiftTool.TOWER: Tower {N} of {COUNT}: {HEIGHT} m tall. Chairs and cabins pass {CLEAR} m above the ground at the tower. Drag to move it.
SkiResort.LiftTool.TOWER_PINNED: Tower {N} of {COUNT}: {HEIGHT} m tall, placed by you. Chairs and cabins pass {CLEAR} m above the ground at the tower.
SkiResort.LiftTool.TOWER_LOW: Tower {N} of {COUNT}: {HEIGHT} m tall. Chairs and cabins come too close to the ground next to it.
SkiResort.LiftTool.NOTHING_TO_BUILD: Nothing to build yet: click both ends of the line first.
SkiResort.LiftTool.NO_START: Click next to a station's line stub, or the loose end of a lift line.
SkiResort.LiftTool.TYPE_UNUSABLE: This lift type cannot be drawn yet.
SkiResort.LiftTool.SAME_END: That is the first end: click the other one.
SkiResort.LiftTool.SAME_STATION: That is the first station: click the other one.
SkiResort.LiftTool.TOO_SHORT: These ends are too close together: a lift line needs at least {MIN} m.
SkiResort.LiftTool.STATION_UNUSABLE: This station cannot take a lift line.
SkiResort.LiftTool.STATION_HAS_LINE: This station already has its line. To change part of it, bulldoze that section, then click its two loose ends.
SkiResort.LiftTool.NO_STUB: This station has no line stub to start from.
SkiResort.LiftTool.CLICK_ON_LINE: Click on the line itself to add a tower there.
SkiResort.LiftTool.END_GONE: One end of the line is gone. Click both ends again.
SkiResort.LiftTool.SUNK: The station sits low in the slope, so the chairs leave it below the ground. Flatter ground or raising it with Move It helps.
SkiResort.LiftTool.OPEN_END: This end is open ground: place a station here to finish the lift.
SkiResort.LiftTool.ADD_TOO_CLOSE_END: A tower cannot stand that close to the end of the line. Keep {M} m clear of it.
SkiResort.LiftTool.ADD_TOO_CLOSE_TOWER: A tower cannot stand that close to a tower you placed. Keep {M} m between them.
SkiResort.LiftTool.NO_TOWER: There is no tower there to remove.
SkiResort.LiftTool.REFUSED[SteepSlope]: The game cannot build this line: part of it is too steep. Move the tower next to the red part.
SkiResort.LiftTool.REFUSED[OverlapExisti: The game cannot build this line: a tower stands on something. Drag it clear and build again.
SkiResort.LiftTool.REFUSED[LongDistance]: The game cannot build this line: a span is too long. Add a tower and build again.
SkiResort.LiftTool.REFUSED[ShortDistance: The game cannot build this line: two towers stand too close together. Move one and build again.
SkiResort.LiftTool.REFUSED[InWater]: The game cannot build this line: a tower stands in water. Move it to dry ground.
SkiResort.LiftTool.REFUSED[ExceedsCityLi: The game cannot build this line: part of it is outside the city's land.
SkiResort.LiftTool.REFUSED[Other]: The game cannot build this line here. Move the towers away from whatever blocks them and build again.
SkiResort.CatTrack.PROMPT_EMPTY: Click where the cat track starts. Right click closes the tool. To remove a track, use Delete cat tracks in the hub.
SkiResort.CatTrack.PROMPT_ONE: Click the next point of the track. Right click goes back a step.
SkiResort.CatTrack.PROMPT_PATH: Click to add a point. Drag a point to move it. Enter builds the track, right click undoes, Esc closes.
SkiResort.CatTrack.PROMPT_DRAG: Release to put the point here. Right click cancels the move.
SkiResort.CatTrack.PROMPT_DEL_NONE: Delete mode: point at a cat track. Right click leaves delete mode.
SkiResort.CatTrack.PROMPT_DEL_HOVER: Click the cat track to select it. Click it again to delete it. Right click leaves delete mode.
SkiResort.CatTrack.PROMPT_DEL_ARMED: Click again to delete this cat track. The ground stays graded and the fee is not refunded. Right click leaves delete mode.
SkiResort.CatTrack.PLAN: Cat track: {LENGTH} m. Steepest part: {MAX} %, limit {LIMIT} %. Digs {CUT} m³ and fills {FILL} m³.
SkiResort.CatTrack.PLAN_LENGTH: Cat track: {LENGTH} m. Steepest part: {MAX} %, limit {LIMIT} %.
SkiResort.CatTrack.PLAN_STEEP: Too steep: the steepest part is {MAX} %, the limit is {LIMIT} %. Add about {SHORT} m of switchbacks.
SkiResort.CatTrack.PLAN_BANK: In places the hillside is steeper than the track's cut and fill slopes, so some banks stay steep.
SkiResort.CatTrack.GUARD_TOO_LARGE: This track covers too much ground to grade. Use a shorter track.
SkiResort.CatTrack.GUARD_RUN_SHAPE: The track's edges touch. Spread the switchback legs apart or make the track narrower.
SkiResort.CatTrack.GUARD_CROSSING_STEEP: The track crosses a run where the ground is too steep for it. Cross somewhere more level.
SkiResort.CatTrack.GUARD_CROSSED_RUN_BAN: This crossing would change how hard the crossed run is rated. Cross it somewhere else.
SkiResort.CatTrack.GUARD_LOT: The track would be graded under a building or station. Move it clear.
SkiResort.CatTrack.GUARD_LIFT_LINE: The track would be graded under a lift line. Move it clear.
SkiResort.CatTrack.GUARD_WATER: The track would be graded into water. Move it clear.
SkiResort.CatTrack.GUARD_OFF_MAP: The track leaves the map. Keep it inside the map.
SkiResort.CatTrack.NEED_TWO: Click at least two points first.
SkiResort.CatTrack.DEL_WAIT: Wait until the cat track is built.
SkiResort.CatTrack.DEL_ON: Delete mode is on. Click a cat track twice to delete it.
SkiResort.CatTrack.DEL_NO_BUILD: Leave delete mode first. Right click leaves it.
SkiResort.CatTrack.DEL_ARM: Click again to delete this cat track.
SkiResort.CatTrack.DEL_DONE: Cat track deleted. The ground stays graded.
SkiResort.CatTrack.NO_GRADING: Grading is not available on this map.
SkiResort.CatTrack.TOO_STEEP: Too steep: the track needs about {SHORT} m more length. Add a switchback.
SkiResort.CatTrack.RUN_MISSING: The cat track asset did not load. Check that the mod is installed completely.
SkiResort.CatTrack.RUN_REFUSED: The game refuses a cat track here. Move it off what blocks it and press Enter again.
SkiResort.CatTrack.TERRAIN_UNREAD: The terrain could not be read. Try again.
SkiResort.CatTrack.ALREADY_FITS: The ground already fits this track.
SkiResort.CatTrack.WRITE_FAILED: The terrain could not be changed, so nothing was graded. Try again.
SkiResort.CatTrack.UNDO_NONE: There is no grade to undo.
SkiResort.CatTrack.UNDO_GONE: That grade can no longer be undone.
SkiResort.Tooltip.SNOW_LINE: Winter snow line ≈ {SNOW_LINE} m · guns work above ≈ {GUN_LINE} m
